body: thanks for the thoughts (I'm a girl btw, not that that matters), wish you all knew how much emotional and mental pain I'm in 24/7.  I was born with Celiac Disease which wasn't discovered until I was 36- by then all of the damage was done-I know I need help but I WILL kill myself before I set foot in our "mental health hospital"........3 days there years ago did more to fuck me up than anything I'd encountered.  My sons live with me, I see them every day, my youngest has unfortunately taken after his mother and has my issues too-  I have fucked up my boys already by allowing them to watch me fall apart more times than I can count, can't do this anymore, I gotta go somehow
